one_line: State the age range and the promise in text at 0:00, then list the materials in 4 seconds.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld medium shot: a boy about 3 places a coloured stick on a growing layer held against a black chair; a bucket of sticks in front. Voiceover (transcript) and text: "קבלו תרגיל מושלם לילדים מגילאי שלוש ומעלה".
q1_hook.why: An age range and a promise in text and voice in the first second, over a child already absorbed in the build (H1, T3, H6). The sticks in his hand show the product being used at 0:00 (S1), and the benefit lines follow within 7 s (H2).

beats.what: Boy places coloured sticks on a growing layer against a chair; "קבלו תרגיל מושלם ..."
beats.why: Age range and promise over a child already at work

beats.what: Boy stretches sticks across chairs; "התרגיל הזה מפתח את הדמיון ✓", "עובד על מוטוריקה ודורש ריכוז ✓"
beats.why: Two benefits with check marks, quickly

beats.what: "אז מה צריך בשביל זה?", then low shots of chairs with tape and the bucket of sticks
beats.why: A question, then a three-item answer held 1 to 2 s each

beats.what: Floor-level shots of loose sticks; "תנו לילדים מקום להתפרע עם הדמיון שלהם"
beats.why: Permission to let them play, no child on screen

beats.what: A mother's hand with a glass of a drink, the boy behind; "ולכו תכינו לעצמכם קפה טוב ומפנק"
beats.why: The parent's reward, a human beat

beats.what: Boy plays with sticks on the floor; "אל תשכחו לשמור את הסרטון", then a Follow button animation
beats.why: Save and follow asks in the last 5 s

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen and spoken at 0:19: "אל תשכחו לשמור את הסרטון" with a save-icon animation; at 0:20 a follow ask with a Follow button. Caption: "ושתפו עם עוד הורים". No question to answer.
q2_flow.why: A promise, quick benefits and a mid-Reel question keep it moving (H2, R3). The empty-floor shots from 0:08 to 0:15 have no child and little change (R3, R1). The coffee line is a human payoff placed near the end (K6, R4).

q3_cta.what: 0:19 "אל תשכחו לשמור את הסרטון" with a save icon; 0:20-0:23 "ולהמשיך לעקוב לעוד פעילויות קלילות ומענות לחופש הגדול" with a Follow button animation (also voiced). Caption: "תמשיכו לעקוב" and "ושתפו עם עוד הורים".
q3_cta.why: Said and shown after the value (C6), and the save ask has a purpose because the materials list is worth keeping (R7). But there are three asks, save, follow and share (C1), and "share with other parents" names no person or reason (C4). The text sits low (C6).

q4_shown.what: A boy about 3 building with coloured sticks on chairs 0:00-0:07; two chairs with tape and a bucket of sticks, low floor shots 0:08-0:11; loose sticks on the floor 0:12-0:15; a mother's hand with a glass 0:16; the boy playing 0:19-0:24. No finished result is clearly shown.
q4_shown.why: The product, craft sticks, is already handled at 0:00 (S1). The materials are shown item by item as household things. The build itself is hard to read at phone size, so the proof is the child's focus (F4). The child's face is shown with no name (S5).

q5_edit.what: 6 shots in 24 s, about 4 s each; hard cuts between handheld shots; subtitles in two lines synced to the voiceover, with check marks on two benefit lines. Save and Follow animations at 0:19-0:23. Ends on the boy playing, with no end card.
q5_edit.why: Motion and the point arrive in the first 3 s (E1) and a cut every few seconds keeps a moderate pace (E2). Voice with synced subtitles works muted (E4). The floor-only shots in the middle slow it down (R3).

q6_topic.what: A near-free home activity with craft sticks, two chairs and tape for children 3 and up, ending with a parent's coffee break. Serves parents with a long holiday to fill.
q6_topic.why: A practical idea wrapped in a child's focus and a parent's break line (K4). The holiday and the tired-parent tone touch a real concern (K6). Claims such as "develops imagination" are modest and generic (K4). A parent can send it to another parent (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone in a bright living room: medium shots of the boy from slightly above, low floor-level shots of chairs and sticks, a table shot with a hand and a glass, a steadier medium shot at the end.
q7_filmed.why: A home, a phone and daylight look native (H8, F7). The sticks and tape are small in the medium shots, so the build is unclear (F4). The Follow button and subtitles sit around two thirds down, in the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: White subtitles with a dark edge, two lines, small, centred about 70% down, phrase by phrase: "קבלו תרגיל מושלם לילדים מגילאי שלוש ומעלה" (0:00), "התרגיל הזה מפתח את הדמיון ✓" (0:03), "שתי כיסאות דבק סלוטייפ" (0:08), "ומקלות צבעוניים" (0:10), "אל תשכחו לשמור את הסרטון" (0:19), "ולהמשיך לעקוב לעוד פעילויות קלילות ומענות לחופש הגדול" (0:20).
q8_text.caption: "תרגיל מקלות מושלם שאתם יכולים לעשות בבית ממש עכשיו!". About 30 words: a follow ask and a share ask, 3 hashtags (#פעילות #ילדים #חופשגדול). No question.
q8_text.why: A headline in the first second states age and promise (T3), and the list is held long enough to read (T5). The text is full sentences near the product and low in the frame (T2, T4). The caption's first line holds the hook and the hashtags are specific (T7).

weak_points: The build is hard to read at phone size; empty-floor shots from 0:08 to 0:15; three asks at the end; generic developmental claims; text low in the frame; the child's face on screen.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with the age range and promise as text over hands paging the book, list what is needed in one 4 s card, and end with one ask.
not_verified: How the sticks are attached (taped between chairs or threaded) is only partly visible. Whose voice it is. Music is not evident. Whether the woman's hand at 0:16 is the creator's. Correction to src/coded: the boy's face is visible, 0:00-0:07 and 0:19-0:24, not hands only; "A3" in the transcript is a mishearing of the subtitle "שלוש".
